mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_code, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM public.organizations WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, organization_code, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM public.organizations WHERE organization_code = #{code}

SELECT id, organization_code, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM public.organizations WHERE tax_code = #{taxCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.organizations ( id, organization_code, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationCode}, #{organizationName}, #{taxCode}, #{address}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactJobTitle}, #{note}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
